context.scopeNote: National totals = sum of the 8 divisions.

alerts.title: High dry-season water stress
alerts.message: Dry-season (Dec-Apr) stress ratio is 50% of usable supply.
alerts.recommendation: Prioritise domestic supply, promote Alternate Wetting and Drying in Boro rice and review groundwater abstraction schedules (see Water Budget optimizer).

alerts.title: Declining regional water storage (GRACE)
alerts.message: Bangladesh-wide storage anomaly trend is -0.53 cm/yr (95% CI -0.61 to -0.45). Regional signal, not well depth.
alerts.recommendation: Treat groundwater as a finite buffer: avoid expanding dry-season abstraction without monitoring.
alerts.rule: GRACE trend < -0.5 cm/yr and CI upper bound < 0 (Assumption: alert when the GRACE storage trend falls below -0.5 cm/yr and its 95% CI excludes 0)
